parameters.content:
## Daily content digest
Every weekday at 9:00 (or on demand through the webhook), reads every request in the Notion tracker, page by page, and posts one message to the team channel: what publishes soon and is not scheduled yet, what has been waiting for review and for how long, what needs a person, and what failed. If Notion or Slack fail after 3 tries, #ops-alerts hears about it once.
